PP2 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Sorting & at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Sorting & using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Sorting & completely.
   C. Sorting & is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sorting &.

2. About Sorting & using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Sorting & at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Sorting & completely.
   C. Sorting & is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sorting &.

3. About Sorting & when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Sorting & helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Sorting & completely.

   D. There is no need to practise Sorting &.

   A. Ordering helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
